prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Athena high-fidelity desktop web product direction comp, exact 1536 × 1024 landscape canvas
Primary request: Generate a completely new, shippable-looking first-screen desktop UI for Athena, a testing-centered intelligent work platform. The visual system is an authentic digital CUTTING BENCH: a black operational workbench dominated by one continuous horizontal film-edit rail. The rail is the only primary organizing structure. This must be an independent interface world, not derived from a ticket, wallet, boarding pass, coupon, document pack, or card table.
Scene/backdrop: flat orthographic browser-content screenshot only, no browser chrome or device frame. At least 75% of the canvas is deep matte black #080808. No large white paper workspace. Warm white is used mainly for type, thin dividers, and compact data surfaces.
Subject and hierarchy:
1. Compact black top command bar with “ATHENA”, “示例项目 · 支付回归”, role context, and a highly visible exact disclosure “目标态 · 合成示例”.
2. Directly below, one fixed-height full-width horizontal film rail, visually unmistakable as the master structure. It contains exactly eight adjacent dark frames in this exact order, with these exact readable labels: “需求”, “证据”, “用例”, “脚本”, “验证”, “Attempt”, “结果”, “RCA”. Every frame has a small monospaced frame number 01–08. Evenly spaced orange #D85E28 perforation pitch runs continuously along the rail’s upper and lower edges. Thin warm-white frame dividers cut through the rail.
3. “05 验证” is the current stop. Mark it with a clear folded orange stop flag attached to the rail and one rough grease-pencil cross. Expand this frame downward into the dominant working bay without turning it into a rounded card.
4. Directly beneath the rail, hang two narrow trimmed work segments from visible small metal pins and short vertical stems. Label them “TRIM 04 · 2 项待评审” and “TRIM 06 · 1 个阻塞”. These hanging trims are dark cut-strip fragments with tiny orange perforations and clipped ends, not paper tags.
5. Expanded validation bay: a disciplined three-zone test-script bench on black. Left zone “来源与用例” shows compact revision anchors and a selected test case. Center zone “脚本候选 v1.2.0” shows a readable semantic diff/code structure with line numbers and restrained orange changed-line marks. Use exact state terms “事实”, “候选”, “已验证”. Right zone “确定性门禁” uses the same rail grammar: stacked short dark frame segments joined by an orange perforated edge, showing “结构校验 · 通过”, “依赖检查 · 通过”, “来源覆盖 · 7/8”, and “评审检查点 · 待确认”. End with a hard-edged orange action “启动受控执行”.
6. Along the bottom, a narrow playback/attempt scrub line connects a small “Attempt 2” marker to “Run #184”, execution evidence, and an “RCA 候选” stop. It should read as controllable software-test history, not cinema decoration.
Native product language: use Athena testing terms only: requirements, source revisions, test cases, script candidate, semantic diff, deterministic gates, review, Attempt, Run, evidence, and RCA. A slim module switcher may show “工作台”, “知识”, “测试设计”, “脚本”, “执行”, “结果”, but the film rail remains the dominant interaction model.
Style/medium: realistic high-fidelity enterprise software UI, technically implementable, dark editorial-industrial information design. Square geometry, hard cuts, exposed alignment rules, monospaced frame numerals, calibrated spacing. No card garden and no skeuomorphic physical scene.
Composition/framing: exact 3:2 desktop composition at 1536 × 1024. Rail occupies the upper quarter and spans nearly the full usable width. Expanded active validation bay fills the middle and lower canvas. The right inspector is integrated into the same rail/perforation grammar rather than a separate white sidebar. Clear task hierarchy and readable Chinese at desktop scale.
Lighting/mood: flat digital UI lighting; serious, high-trust, technical, controlled, precise.
Color palette: dominant matte black #080808; functional burnt orange #D85E28; warm white #F4F0E8; secondary gray #6B6660. Orange is visible in the continuous perforation pitch, current-frame bar, stop flag, grease cross, hanging trim perforations, changed code lines, and primary action. No navy, blue, red, purple, or gradients.
Materials/textures: subtle fine black workbench grain; coarse screenprinted grain inside orange marks; warm-white hairline rules; grease-pencil cross and circle; folded orange stop flag; tiny metal hanging pins. Keep surfaces digital and flat.
Text (verbatim): “ATHENA”, “目标态 · 合成示例”, “示例项目 · 支付回归”, “需求”, “证据”, “用例”, “脚本”, “验证”, “Attempt”, “结果”, “RCA”, “TRIM 04 · 2 项待评审”, “TRIM 06 · 1 个阻塞”, “来源与用例”, “脚本候选 v1.2.0”, “事实”, “候选”, “已验证”, “确定性门禁”, “结构校验 · 通过”, “依赖检查 · 通过”, “来源覆盖 · 7/8”, “评审检查点 · 待确认”, “启动受控执行”, “Run #184”, “RCA 候选”
Constraints: render the eight lifecycle labels in exact order and clearly legible; black workbench must dominate the entire composition, not just the shell; horizontal rail must be the single unmistakable primary structure; orange perforation pitch, frame numbers, folded stop flag, grease-pencil cross, and hanging-pin trims must all be visibly present; right-side gates must reuse the rail grammar; distinguish facts, candidates, and verified states; all data is visibly synthetic; no real customers, logos, testimonials, metrics, or watermark.
Avoid: tickets, ticket wallets, travel wallets, journey wallets, boarding passes, coupons, coupon perforations, airline language, export-ticket actions, paper-ticket silhouettes, scalloped coupon edges, white document packs, traceability spreadsheets, generic white dashboard, rows of rounded cards, movie stills, photographs, cinema posters, Hollywood styling, ancient Greece, Athena goddess imagery, owls, columns, gradients, glassmorphism, neon, glossy 3D, generic chatbot layout, KPI tiles, marketing landing page, illegible microtext, nonsense labels.
